instruction.task: Write a Bitburner script that continuously hacks servers to maximize money. The script should: 1) Scan all reachable servers from 'home', 2) For each server, try to gain root access by running NUKE.exe and any port-opening programs if available (BruteSSH.exe, FTPCrack.exe, etc.), 3) Find the best server to hack (highest money, low security, within your hacking level), 4) Continuously hack/weaken/grow that server in a loop. Use only cheap RAM calls: ns.hack, ns.weaken, ns.grow, ns.scan, ns.getServerMaxMoney, ns.getServerMoneyAvailable, ns.getServerSecurityLevel, ns.getServerMinSecurityLevel, ns.getServerRequiredHackingLevel, ns.getHackingLevel, ns.getServerNumPortsRequired, ns.fileExists, ns.nuke, ns.brutessh, ns.ftpcrack, ns.relaysmtp, ns.httpworm, ns.sqlinject, ns.sleep. Do NOT use ns.getServer() (too expensive). The script should run forever, hacking in a loop. Target the server with the best ratio of (maxMoney / requiredHackingLevel) that you can access. When security is high (>5 above min), weaken it. When money is low (<75% of max), grow it. Otherwise hack it.
